The '''Imperial laboratory''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[D'vouran]] was an abandoned underground [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]]. The facility was discovered by [[Kevreb Bebo]] after his ship, the ''[[Misanthrope]]'' crash-landed on the planet. Bebo later showed the facility to [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]] and [[DV-9]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. The facility had [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] markings and was left with no vital information as all the computers were either taken or their files deleted. At one end of the facility was an entryway into a large cavern that appeared to have no bottom. Some vials of chemicals and an [[D'vouran amulet|amulet]] were left at the site. The amulet was passed from Bebo to Tash Arranda for her to use as safe keeping. As she left, a [[Gank/Legends|Gank]] [[Gank/Legends|killer]] murdered Bebo by throwing him into the depths of the planet. It was later revealed that the laboratory was a location used during [[Project Starscream]], in which the sentient planet was created.
